messages:
anna-fin: Quick alert — running the February embed reconciliation I found a net negative of 12,842 embed units for Acero after the Jan->Feb backfill. System applied an auto-credit for $2,390. Posting summary and asking ops + CS for next steps.

raj-ops: Which backfill job id? Any raw ledger lines we can inspect?

anna-fin: backfill job: bf-2026-02-12-770. Ledger snapshot: inserts 1,102,332; deletes 1,115,174 => net -12,842. I pulled CSV into the ticket.

reconcile-bot: Auto-rule "backfill_decrement_protect" fired for customer=acero between 2026-02-12 and 2026-02-13. Credits issued: 12842 embed units; amount $2,390. See /billing/credits/10022

tom-ledger: Ops recently changed the backfill dedupe semantics to treat missing idempotency keys as deletes in some edge cases. Worth checking if client SDK sent duplicate ids.

emily-cs: If we're going to reverse anything we need CS on the thread. Acero is sensitive to invoice churn. Suggest offering a small goodwill credit if reversal is necessary.

raj-ops: Root fix: update the backfill reconciler to ignore replay deletes unless explicit correction flag present. We'll run a non-destructive simulation against the March window and share results. ETA 5 business days.

anna-fin: Finance preference: reverse the automatic credit and reissue invoice, but only after CS outreach and legal sign-off for reversals above $1k. @tom-ledger please attach ledger CSV and reconciliation diff to the finance ticket.

billing-bot: Ticket created BILL-4987 (Acero embed credit review) and assigned to billing-team.

emily-cs: I'll schedule a 20-min sync with Acero and loop legal if needed. Please draft customer note before outreach.

anna-fin: Draft note: "Hi Acero — during a routine backfill we identified an internal count adjustment that temporarily generated a credit on your February invoice. We're reviewing the reconciliation and will follow up with a corrected invoice or a reconciled explanation within 3 business days. We'll share the ledger extract and offer a one-time courtesy credit where appropriate. Apologies for the confusion."

raj-ops: We'll also run a one-off audit job to confirm no other customers affected and post results to the ticket.

anna-fin: Marking this P1. Finance will hold reversal until CS outreach and legal OK. Close loop once reversal/reissue completes.
